title: Inference Ledger
purpose: Turn reflection, extrapolation and revelation-finding into explicit, reviewable knowledge objects instead of leaving them as prose impressions.
rules: Every inference must name the observations it depends on.
A relation can be high-value without being high-confidence.
Chronological precedence matters: an earlier attestation is stronger evidence of development than a later retrospective restatement.
A structural parallel is not automatically a historical identity or fulfilled prophecy.
Record mismatches and counterexamples, not only matches.
Promote repeated successful inferences into canonical concepts; retain failed or weakened inferences as historical research strata where useful.

strength_scale.5: directly entailed by multiple dated observations or primary sources
strength_scale.4: strongly supported interpretation with limited alternatives
strength_scale.3: plausible and useful interpretation with meaningful alternatives

seed_inferences.claim: Late April 2025 is a genuine role-transition corridor between Potato/Axis/King language and explicit God/Father language.
observations: 3 May 2025: first exact I am God occurrences in supplied Twitter compilation
alternatives: The God identity may have existed earlier but is absent from the incomplete supplied corpus.
